caption: The image shows a rectangular embroidered sampler with a cream-colored background. At the top, there are rows of stitched decorative borders in green and gold, followed by lines of the alphabet in uppercase cursive and block letters, stitched in shades of blue, gray, and gold. Below these lines, there are the initials "I. M." on the left, "T." in the middle, and "S." on the right. Occupying the lower section of the sampler is a depiction of a large, four-story house with a red roof, beige walls, and green window shutters and door. The house is centered, and it is flanked symmetrically by two large green trees with round tops. In front of the house, there is a brown gate and a walkway leading up to the door, with green shrubs and small plants on either side. At the bottom of the sampler, stitched text reads: "When I have done with all below / And conquered all my fears / Look here my friends & rubear a thought, / Upon the one by whom t’was wrought." The entire sampler is bordered with a stitched pattern in green thread.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
